long_biography.plain_text:
Samuel Hamin Fleet showed an entrepreneurial bent early, recalling that at eleven he bought the paper routes in his Swampscott, Massachusetts neighbourhood and sold them to the Boston Globe. He entered life insurance and founded National Employee Benefit Companies five years later, turning the business into a recognised third-party administrator.

Amwins acquired NEBCO in 2000, and Fleet remained to build its Group Benefits division through product development, acquisitions and specialty benefit services. His work included digital broker tools, retiree prescription programmes and self-funded health solutions. After twenty-four years leading the division, he handed the presidency to Riva Dumeny in 2024 and became a senior adviser.
